root_cause.text: The secure storage access exception handler for kernel-context pages incorrectly treats the absence of the PG_arch_1 bit as indicating the page is already exported and accessible, while for memory donated to the Ultravisor the bit is also absent but the page is not accessible, causing an infinite exception loop.
root_cause.evidence: CVE description states: "Prior to this patch we would try to export the page by calling arch_make_folio_accessible() which would instantly return since the arch bit is absent signifying that the page was already exported and no further action is necessary. This leads to secure storage access exception loops which can never be resolved." The patch changes the handler to unconditionally call uv_convert_from_secure() and on failure use handle_fault_error_nolock() instead of BUG().
